description: This file defines a central routing configuration for a Flutter application using the go_router package. It sets up routes for splash, home, game, and settings screens, and provides an error UI for navigation errors.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: An abstract final class that provides a static instance of GoRouter configured with application routes.

methods.name: router
methods.description: A static final instance of GoRouter that defines app routing including routes and error handling.
